_comment: Swiss Ephemeris data files fetched by ci/fetch_swiss_ephemeris.py for the
swiss-ephemeris CI job (CALC-1). These are the four files this service needs to
run on real ephemeris data instead of swisseph's built-in Moshier fallback, so a
CI run exercises exactly the data the image is volume-mounted with in production.
The files are distributed under the Swiss Ephemeris dual licence (AGPL-3.0 or a
paid Professional Licence); this service uses them under AGPL-3.0 — the same
licence it ships under — so fetching them in CI is within those terms. They are
deliberately NOT committed (see .gitignore: data/ephe/): ~2 MB of binary data
with its own licence does not belong in this git history.
SOURCE: the upstream Swiss Ephemeris distribution repository (aloistr/swisseph),
pinned to a COMMIT sha rather than a branch, so the path itself is
content-addressed and cannot move under us. EPHEMERIS_LICENSE.md used to point at
https://www.astro.com/ftp/ephe/ ; every astro.com path we probed now returns 404
(checked 2026-07-25: /ftp/ephe/, /ftp/swisseph/ephe/, /swisseph/ephe/), which is
why that doc now points here too.
sha256 is trust-on-first-use, exactly like a lockfile entry: recorded from the
first verified download and pinned thereafter, so a later silent change to a
published file fails the job instead of quietly shifting every golden value.
Updating one is a reviewable diff, never an automatic refresh. A null sha256 is
NOT 'skip the check' — the fetcher fails closed and prints the value to record.
